permissions.title: Page permissions
permissions.inheritParent: Use the parent page’s view, edit and comment permissions.
permissions.inheritRoot: Without a parent, all active members can view, edit and comment. The admin-only editing restriction still applies.
permissions.matchAny: For each permission, allow system roles, positions or specific members. Matching any selected option grants access.
permissions.hierarchy: Parent restrictions always apply. A child page can narrow access but cannot expand its parent’s permissions.
permissions.emptyDenied: Leaving a permission empty denies it to everyone. Keep your own view access.
permissions.moveHint: Moving a page applies the new parent’s restrictions and may change who can access it. Only administrators can move pages.
permissions.viewRequired: Editing and commenting require view access first. Administrators do not bypass view restrictions. Positions match each member’s current job title.
permissions.noPositions: No job titles have been set
permissions.restricted: This page has custom permissions. Parent restrictions still apply.

qa.boardHint: Open a card for details. Available next steps appear at the bottom of each card.
qa.workflowHint: The company shares one workflow. Rename and reorder columns; grouped columns preserve each Bug's actual stage and verification requirements.
qa.workflowLabelHint: Names are limited to 40 characters and must be distinct. Leave a name blank to use the default translation.
qa.slackUsage: Use /livo bug new or the message shortcut to report a bug. Use /livo bug link BUG_ID in the destination channel to share and bind its thread. A fix needs a build/version; PASS requires a recorded deployment.
qa.slackCloud: Cloudflare QA actions require the Slack command/interaction endpoint and signing secret to be configured. Access matches a verified Slack email to an active LIVO member in the same Slack workspace. This page does not confirm that the connection is active.
qa.slackGate: Both QA and Slack actions must be enabled. Docker continues to support administrator-managed account bindings.
qa.slackFeatureDescription: Allow configured Slack interactions: QA commands on Cloudflare, and task/QA interactions on Docker. QA actions also require the QA switch.
qa.title: QA Bugs
qa.featureDescription: Report, triage, fix and verify bugs. Turning this off hides QA and stops QA access; existing records are kept.
qa.taskLinksHint: Select the development tasks involved. Completing a task does not close this bug.
qa.attachmentHint: Up to 200 MB per file. Files require QA access; videos play after a private download.
qa.disabled: QA is turned off. An administrator can enable it in system settings.
qa.demo: Demo data stays in this browser tab.
qa.failed: The request failed. Your input is kept; you can retry.
qa.conflict: This bug changed while you were editing. Your input is kept. Refresh the latest record, review it, then submit again.
qa.refreshKept: The record was refreshed. Your unsent input is still here.
qa.noPermission: No workflow action is available for your role at this stage.
qa.unsent: Unsent changes are kept when refreshing.
qa.problemAreaHint: Describe the affected feature or screen, such as login, wallet, or checkout.
qa.fixComponentHint: Enter the component being fixed and deployed, such as frontend, API, or settlement service. It may differ from the affected feature.
qa.versionHint: Enter a version or choose from this project’s QA history. Leave blank if unknown.
qa.versionLoadFailed: Version suggestions are unavailable. You can still enter a version.
qa.versionEmpty: This project has no version history yet. Enter a version directly.
qa.fixVersionHint: Type a build, version or commit ID for this fix, or choose a recorded version from this project.
qa.createIntro: Describe the problem and add evidence to help the team reproduce it.
qa.workspaceIntro: Track issues through repair and verification.
qa.acknowledgeHistoricalPass: I have reviewed the original PASS evidence and accept it to close this Bug. This does not record a new verification.
qa.dropFiles: Drop files here, or click to choose
qa.draftFileHint: Select multiple files, up to 200 MB each
qa.fileSizeError: Files must be nonempty and no larger than 200 MB
qa.fileTypeError: This file type or extension is not supported
qa.fileNameError: Invalid or overly long filename; please rename it
qa.createdAttachmentsPending: Bug created. Attachments are being processed.
qa.attachmentRetryHint: The Bug is saved. Retry unfinished attachments; completed files will not upload again.
qa.createRetryHint: The create result has not arrived. Retry to recover the same Bug. Fields are locked to prevent duplicates.
qa.openWithoutPendingFiles: Skip unfinished files and open Bug
qa.createAttachmentHint: Attachments upload after the Bug is created. Stay on this page until they finish.
qa.attachmentsRefreshFailed: Attachments were saved, but the list could not refresh. Please reload.
qa.finishPending: Finish or cancel the current QA action before leaving this page.
